audits.claim_reasoning: The relevant contract links vote.commit to summary.advance through summary-lag, with vote.commit producing one unit and summary.advance consuming one unit. Three summarizer workers and the assumed 200 ms worst-case service envelope yield 3/0.2 = 15 modeled updates per second, while the 200 ms maximum vote cadence yields at most 5 generations per second (the checker conservatively reports a 10/s maximum generation rate). The checker result passes with maximum_generations 3. The evidence does not execute a queue, scheduler, or concurrent summarizer pool; it measures ten successful calls to a pure increment function. That gap would invalidate an operational lag promise, but not this narrowly worded modeled-capacity claim.
